source_binding.mechanism: stratified coverage plus equivalence-partition-style evidence grouping

public_sources.claim_used: Stratified sampling first separates a population into non-overlapping strata and then obtains a sample from each stratum, rather than allowing one region to dominate the sample.

Equivalence partitioning derives distinct test conditions by partitioning inputs or outputs into classes expected to be treated similarly, so coverage can be expressed over partitions rather than raw test count.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No survey system, test runner, hosted service, cloud compute, external model, or user execution is required. The source mechanisms are reduced to a finite role-local coverage rule evaluated directly in recurring Chat.
source_binding.chat_native_reduction: Predeclare three acceptance-relevant evidence strata and require one unique fresh same-scope terminal PASS from each for the current candidate/generation. Treat semantically equivalent evidence as one coverage item; extra items from an already-covered stratum cannot replace a missing stratum.

scope_limit: Constructed three-stratum trace only. Coverage over a fixed taxonomy does not establish that the taxonomy is complete; unknown future failure regions can remain outside S_NORMAL/S_BOUNDARY/S_RECOVERY.
unresolved_child: A fixed stratum taxonomy can miss a novel failure regime. A later leaf should test an explicit UNKNOWN/UNCLASSIFIED evidence path that blocks automatic promotion and safely expands taxonomy only for a later generation.

quota_cost_assessment.repository_transport_note: Repository API is lightweight state/evidence transport only; rate-limit interruption is checkpoint/retryable and API volume is not used as compute.
